description: Generate a complete KERNEL_CONFIG JSON for a Trilobio (tcode-api) fleet controller. Wraps `buildTrilobioConfig()` from the @pcc/trilobio npm package. Returns a TrilobioKernelConfig with sensible defaults (pollIntervalMs=3000, maxScriptTimeoutSec=3600, allowArbitraryScripts=false). The result can be passed to `pcc-node start` via the KERNEL_CONFIG env var, or handed to setup_generate_config / setup_register_device for direct API-driven registration. Note: this is a TypeScript package helper (no HTTP call). For programmatic use, `import { buildTrilobioConfig } from "@pcc/trilobio"`.

allowArbitraryScripts.description: Permit customer-supplied tcode-api Python scripts (true) or only curated protocol IDs (false). Default: false. Set true only for trusted-counterparty deployments.

apiKey.description: Trilobio fleet-controller API key (from the trilobot admin UI). Either apiKey OR username+password is required unless mockMode=true.

deviceId.description: Logical device ID within the kernel (default: trilobio-fleet-01)

kernelId.description: Kernel ID this device belongs to (auto-generated as kernel_trilobio_<timestamp> if omitted)

maxScriptTimeoutSec.description: Maximum allowed wall-clock seconds for a single tcode script (range 30-86400). Default: 3600.

mockMode.description: Bypass real HTTP and simulate runs. Use for CI / floor demos. Default: false.

mockRunDurationMs.description: Mock-mode simulated run duration in ms. Default: 2000.

pollIntervalMs.description: Poll interval in ms for run status (range 500-60000). Default: 3000.

tcodeApiVersion.description: Pinned tcode-api version on the fleet controller. Format: 'latest' or semver (e.g. 1.25.1). Default: latest. Surfaces in evidence bundles for reproducibility.

url.description: Fleet-controller URL on the LAN (host[:port], no trailing slash, no path) — e.g. http://192.168.1.50

name: pcc_trilobio_build_config
